title: Kerberos: fix / update PKINIT dissector
description:
Support these later additions to Kerberos PKINIT:

* freshness tokens (RFC-8070)
* `supportedKDFs` (RFC-8636)

and also fix/update PKINIT AS-REP definition regarding:

* `dhSignedData`/`dhInfo`
* `kdf` (also RFC-8636)

See commit messages for further details.

notes.body:
I'm attaching a packet capture demonstrating the issues fixed, in the AS-REQ/AS-REP pair at frames 8 and 10 (as shown in the commit messages).

* [packets.pcapng](/uploads/b8f7674415bd5d305d3a74a174d34af9/packets.pcapng)
* [keytab](/uploads/b3749ce87b2067b8b90082e10ced81bf/keytab)

I see that the *Clang + Code Checks* stage failed. I'm confused because:

1. that didn't happen when I created a test MR in my fork of the repository (all stages of the pipeline passed), and
2. if I'm reading the job output right, none of the warnings have to do with any of the code I changed (which just shows up in the diff at the bottom).

The job failed because when it regenerated the dissector from the ASN1 it didn't match.

I'm not sure exactly how you regenerated it (as you said it didn't match), but you should only make changes to the template and cnf file (and asn), and then it's easiest to regenerate it using the build system target. E.g.,

`ninja generate_dissector-pkinit`

(`ninja asn1` or `make asn1` will do all of them.)

It has the name with `cms` in it because it's importing the dissection from the CMS dissector. If you're not getting it when you're running asn2wrs.py by hand, it's probably because the import isn't working somehow.

I see; thanks. I regenerated the dissector code by running `asn2wrs.py` by hand using the command I found in the comments at the top of the generated files, because I didn't know about those targets. I'll redo it using the latter and see how it goes.
Great; I redid the commits using `ninja generate_dissector-pkinit`, and that fixed the function-renaming issue. I updated the branch and the the validations are running again now.

commits_data.title: Kerberos: fix/update PKINIT AS-REP definition
commits_data.message:
Kerberos: fix/update PKINIT AS-REP definition

The current Wireshark definition is:

  PaPkAsRep ::= CHOICE {
        dhSignedData         [0] ContentInfo,
        ...
  }

but the definition per RFC-4556 and later extensions is:

  PA-PK-AS-REP ::= CHOICE {
     dhInfo                  [0] DHRepInfo,
     ...
  }

  DHRepInfo ::= SEQUENCE {
     dhSignedData            [0] ContentInfo,
     -- actually:
     -- dhSignedData         [0] IMPLICIT OCTET STRING,
     --   -- Contains a CMS type ContentInfo encoded according
     --   -- to [RFC3852] ...
     serverDHNonce           [1] DHNonce OPTIONAL,
     kdf                     [2] KDFAlgorithmId OPTIONAL,
     -- (added by RFC-8636 "PKINIT Algorithm Agility")
     ...
  }

which leads to dissection failure in the DH case:

PA-DATA pA-PK-AS-REP
  padata-type: pA-PK-AS-REP (17)
    padata-value […]: ...
      dhSignedData
        -- SEQUENCE instead of ContentInfo
        BER Error: Wrong field in SEQUENCE:
          expected class:UNIVERSAL(0) tag:6(OBJECT IDENTIFIER)
          but found class:CONTEXT(2) tag:0
        -- 'kdf' element
        BER Error: Wrong field in SEQUENCE:
          expected class:CONTEXT(2) tag:0
          but found class:CONTEXT(2) tag:2

The current version has been there since 2004, so perhaps reflects
some earlier draft version of the spec (which was published in 2006).

With this commit, we get:

----------------------------------------------------------------------
PA-DATA pA-PK-AS-REP
  padata-type: pA-PK-AS-REP (17)
    padata-value […]: a08206c7308...
      dhInfo
        dhSignedData (id-signedData)
          contentType: 1.2.840.113549.1.7.2 (id-signedData)
          SignedData
            version: v3 (3)
            digestAlgorithms: 1 item
              DigestAlgorithmIdentifier (sha256)
                Algorithm Id: 2.16.840.1.101.3.4.2.1 (sha256)
            encapContentInfo (id-pkdhkeydata)
              eContentType: 1.3.6.1.5.2.3.2 (id-pkdhkeydata)
              eContent (282 bytes)
            certificates: 1 item
            ...
        KDCDHKeyInfo
          Padding: 0
          subjectPublicKey […]: 0282010100...
          nonce: 705343466
        kdf
          kdf-id: 1.3.6.1.5.2.3.6.2 (id-pkinit-kdf-ah-sha256)
----------------------------------------------------------------------
